hook_en: He hears you, and He will answer. 🙏
reflect_en: David waited on the LORD with confidence, not doubt: You will answer. As this weekend begins, you can bring Him the prayer you've been carrying and wait with hope, because He is your God and He hears.
q_en: What prayer are you waiting on God to answer?
x_en: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
tiktok: I wait for You, O LORD 🙏 Psalm 38:15 — He will answer, so keep praying this weekend
yt_title: I Wait for You, O LORD; You Will Answer | Psalm 38:15 #Shorts
yt_line: Wait on Him with hope today.
li_open: Waiting well is one of the hardest parts of leading.
li_quote: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
li_body: David didn't wait in silence or despair; he waited on the LORD, confident that God would answer. Leaders who pray and wait with that kind of hope, and walk alongside the people they serve while they wait, help their teams and churches keep trusting through the slow seasons.
hook_es: Él te escucha y te responderá. 🙏
reflect_es: David esperó en Jehová con confianza, no con duda: tú responderás. En este fin de semana puedes traerle la oración que has cargado y esperar con esperanza, porque Él es tu Dios y te escucha.
q_es: ¿Qué oración estás esperando que Dios responda?
x_es: Porque a ti, oh Jehová, esperé yo: tú responderás, Jehová Dios mío.
key_en: You will answer, O Lord my God
